product.title: Scotland's Glens, Highlands & Whisky Day Trip from Edinburgh

description.text: This whisky and waterfalls day from Edinburgh crosses Loch Lomond and The Trossachs National Park, then visits Glenturret Distillery for a tour and dram before The Hermitage, Dunkeld, and Dunkeld Cathedral. An English-speaking guide handles the nine-hour air-conditioned circuit, with lunch at own expense. Stops include Loch Lomond and The Trossachs National Park, Glenturret Distillery, The Hermitage, Dunkeld, Dunkeld Cathedral. Hotel pickup is from the Royal Mile. Forest paths at The Hermitage and the cathedral village close the tasting day. Ideal for visitors basing in Edinburgh who want a guided glen, distillery, and waterfall day without rural self-driving.

highlights: Soak up views of Loch Lomond and Trossachs National Park as your travel
Visit a whisky distillery and sample a wee dram
Walk through the Hermitage, a natural beauty spot with incredible waterfalls
Enjoy a stop in Dunkeld, a village written about in Shakespeare’s 'MacBeth'
